description: This file contains classes and functions for integrating with GitHub, including parsing Python files to identify FastAPI endpoints and classes, managing GitHub repositories, and creating pull requests for code updates and tests.

classes.name: DefinitionVisitor
classes.description: AST NodeVisitor class to identify class definitions, functions, FastAPI app instances, and endpoints within Python source files.

classes.name: RepoHelper
classes.description: Helper class to interact with GitHub repositories, parse Python files for class/function definitions, FastAPI endpoints, and manage pull requests for code updates and testing.

methods.name: visit_ClassDef
methods.description: Visits class definitions in AST and records them.

methods.name: visit_FunctionDef
methods.description: Visits function definitions in AST and processes them, checking for FastAPI endpoint decorators.

methods.name: visit_AsyncFunctionDef
methods.description: Visits asynchronous function definitions in AST and processes them.

methods.name: process_function
methods.description: Processes a function node, checking for FastAPI decorators to identify endpoints.

methods.name: get_integration
methods.description: Initializes GitHub integration using app ID and private key.

methods.name: get_repo_by_url
methods.description: Retrieves the GitHub repository object matching the provided URL.

methods.name: enrich_callgraph_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches nodes in a call graph with GitHub data such as file content and function implementation details.

methods.name: _build_index
methods.description: Builds an index of classes, functions, FastAPI apps, and endpoints from the repository.

methods.name: _process_python_file
methods.description: Parses a Python file, extracts definitions, FastAPI apps, and endpoints, and updates the index.

methods.name: lookup_index
methods.description: Looks up symbols in the index by name and type.

methods.name: get_fastapi_app
methods.description: Returns information about FastAPI app instances found.

methods.name: get_fastapi_endpoints
methods.description: Returns information about FastAPI endpoints found.

methods.name: identify_app_for_endpoint
methods.description: Heuristically determines which FastAPI app a given endpoint belongs to based on directory structure.

methods.name: enrich_node_with_github_data
methods.description: Adds GitHub file path, function implementation, and file content to a node.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_new_function
methods.description: Creates a branch, updates a function implementation, and opens a pull request with context.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_test
methods.description: Creates a branch, adds a new test file, and opens a pull request.

methods.name: create_pull_request_with_multiple_tests
methods.description: Creates a branch, adds multiple test files, and opens a pull request with coverage summary.
